pt.source: linguatag default_region("pt") is PT: a bare tag reads the region where the language first appeared (ovos-spec-tools language, re-exported from linguatag)

fr.source: linguatag default_region("fr") is FR: a bare tag reads the region where the language first appeared (ovos-spec-tools language, re-exported from linguatag)

no.source: ISO 639-3 "nor" (ISO 639-1 "no") is a macrolanguage of Norwegian Bokmål (nb) and Norwegian Nynorsk (nn); numtag reads it as Bokmål, the written standard of most Norwegians, so this is a choice of language and no region rule
